title: Erdős problem #743: tree packing into a complete graph
statement: For any trees T₂,…,Tₙ with Tₖ having k vertices, Kₙ is their edge-disjoint union.

counterexample.description: Give trees T₂ through T₁₀ that have no simultaneous edge-disjoint packing into K₁₀. Each tree uses local vertex labels 0 through k−1.
